name: env_hazards_paramized_defaults
description: v2.1 additive params: env_hazards_cap and env_hazard_points are now in WeatherRegimeParams.g_score_config. Default Taiwan values (cap=3; near_hv_power=3, near_base_station=1, narrow_clearance=2) preserve v2.0 behaviour exactly. With near_hv_power=1 + near_base_station=1 + clearance_m=5 (so narrow_clearance does not fire) + floors=8 (so wind_channel_effect interaction does not fire), env_raw = 3+1+0 = 4, env_score = min(env_hazards_cap=3, 4) = 3, interaction_capped = 0, env_interaction = min(env_interaction_cap=4, 3+0) = 3.
